rationale.intuition: High GPA + Low SAT 的不一致档案。UMich admit SAT 中位 ~1450，1350 低于 25th。Strong GPA 帮助但不抵消 test gap。比 011 case 略略好（GPA 长期信号更稳定），但仍 reach。

sources.name: UMich CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: SAT 25th percentile 1360; applicant SAT 1350 just below — triggers 'just below 25th' band (×0.7 in counselor-modifiers.ts post-fix)

sources.name: NACAC State of College Admission 2024
sources.evidence: High-GPA-low-test profiles get partial credit but test gap is a flag for many T30 admissions committees
